source_signature.notes: Batch 4F skill 2/5. Scope Operator-derived. FIRST multi-parent synthesis skill of 4F and first STATICS_STRUCTURAL_ANALYSIS sign-off. A simple truss is a MODELING idealization that precedes any solution method; this skill stops at the model and the determinacy count and never solves. Synthesis of three signed parents, verified woven not restated: two_force_member_identification (3ba94601) supplies why every member is axial-only — loaded at two joints, no intermediate load, collinear along the member; support_reaction_modeling supplies r, the reaction-component count from the catalog; constraints_static_determinacy supplies the determinacy LOGIC, here specialised from n_e = 3 to the truss count m + r vs 2j. The misconception owned: students treat the three assumptions (frictionless-pin joints, joint-only loading, axial-only straight members) as physical facts rather than modeling choices, and conflate simple-by-construction (m = 2j − 3) with determinate-by-count (m + r = 2j). The worked example, Operator-re-derived, makes both bite: j=4, m=5, m=2j−3 holds; Arrangement 1 (pin+roller) r=3, m+r=8=2j determinate; Arrangement 2 (pin+pin) r=4, m+r=9>8 indeterminate though STILL simple by construction — the simple≠determinate contrast; Arrangement 3 puts a load at the midpoint of BC, violating joint-only loading so BC is not two-force and the model is invalid. A single clean truss with nothing to contrast would have made the modeling test unmeasurable — the defect family caught on contact_force_modeling and two_force_member_identification. Method of joints, method of sections, and zero-force-member rules are the downstream ceiling (method_of_joints owns solving); no step solves, writes joint equations, identifies zero-force members, analyses frames/machines, or goes 3D. SIGNAL MAPPING, corrected at the review beat to a single content-earned signal: unclassified at step 6. The draft first carried sign_or_placement_error at step 1, but step 1 only INVENTORIES (lists joints, members, supports, load locations) and assigns no line of action or sense — the probe confirmed only step 2 references placement, and that is a citation of two_force_member_identification, not this skill placing a vector. The three failure modes bundled under that signal resolve to a modeling error, a miscount, and inventory bookkeeping, all of which fall to unclassified or the Decision B debt class; the signal named a placement the step does not perform. It was removed and its real error content folded into the unclassified@6 trigger, so coverage is preserved. This matches constraints_static_determinacy, the other count-and-classify skill, which also carries unclassified alone. SIGNAL-POLICY DEBT per Decision B, now a SECOND instance: modeling-error subclasses (assumption-as-fact, invalid-model-accepted, miscount) have no canonical signal and collapse onto unclassified. Two count-and-classify skills now show this — constraints_static_determinacy and simple_truss_modeling — which suggests the gap is structural to identification/modeling/classification skills that never resolve a vector, not incidental. Flagged for an Architect taxonomy ruling before Phase E authors questions against these procedures. axis_confusion omitted: no component-resolution step. simple_average_used omitted: Centroids-family. No content defect at the review beat; the only correction was the signal mapping.
